title: Maximum distance calculation
description: Essential: Correctly computes the maximum separation (16 m) between car A and the truck before overtaking.

title: Overtaking time calculation
description: Essential: Correctly determines the minimum time (7 s) for car A to complete the overtaking maneuver.

title: Safety analysis conclusion
description: Essential: Correctly concludes that car A cannot safely overtake without car B's deceleration.

title: Required deceleration calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the minimum deceleration (-1 m/s²) required for car B to allow safe overtaking.

title: Relative motion setup
description: Important: Applies kinematics equations to model the relative positions of car A and the truck during acceleration.

title: Overtaking displacement condition
description: Important: Sets up the correct displacement relationship (x_A - x_truck = s) to solve for the overtaking time.

title: Collision condition analysis
description: Important: Correctly compares the sum of displacements of car A and car B to their initial separation to assess safety.

title: Deceleration kinematics application
description: Important: Uses the correct kinematics equation (involving average velocity) to solve for car B's required final speed and deceleration.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Makes a sign error in relative displacements, accelerations, or velocities, leading to an incorrect physical conclusion.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (m, s, m/s²) throughout all calculations and final answers.
